params.name: start_date
params.description: The date from which aggregation results will start. This is translated into a start_time, which is the beginning of the date presented in the timezone of the page's Campaign. If the Fundraising Page's Campaign has no associated timezone, this timezone will default to UTC.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The date at which aggregation results will end. This is translated into a end_time, which is the end of the date presented in the timezone of the page's Campaign. If the Fundraising Page's Campaign has no associated timezone, this timezone will default to UTC.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for start_date and end_date.
